bandReviews.observations: Opening clef/key/6/8 and Vivace, full-bar rests, first high staccato figure and dots, f/sf/sf and later f, and final notes/barline are complete. The fragment beneath the staff is neighboring notation; target dynamics remain distinct.

All nine measures are complete, including middle high ledger notes and accents, both low f markings, right-hand accidentals and final rests. Neighbor fragments occur below the crop, without obscuring the target staff.

Opening two rest measures, full entry f, complete rehearsal A frame, both seven-note runs and numerals, and upper slurs/high terminal noteheads match the original. Adjacent-staff fragments below are retained.

Opening high note and short slur, complete seven-note run and long slur, sustained flats/accents, all high dots/ledger notes/accidentals at the right, and all four sf markings are intact. Nearby unrelated ink is retained around target dynamics.
Opening descending groups and high slurs, naturals, full rehearsal B frame, fp, and ending sustained paired notes with slurs are complete. Neighboring material below remains visible and separable.

Every continuous beamed figure and accidental is intact, including complete upper slurs, the long diminuendo hairpin below the middle, full dolce legg. text, and the low right-hand note/natural/slur. Neighboring notation remains below.

Opening note/rests, complete fp descenders, sustained flat-note figures and slurs, following rising/falling runs, low flats and ledger notes are preserved. In particular the adjacent second-violin upward flag remains beside fp rather than removing part of the dynamic.

All five measures preserve the first two runs and lower slurs, low accidentals, third-measure high peak/slur, complete dim. including initial d, and final low ledger notes. Adjacent-staff fragments are retained below.

Complete rehearsal C frame, opening flat/rests and full-bar rest, both pp markings, full long upper slur, ending lower ties/slurs and the right-edge 2/4 change are present. Neighbor fragments remain outside the target staff.

Opening 2/4, clef/key and articulated groups, central 6/8 with sustained tied notes, later 2/4 and final beams/short slurs match the original. Both high and low target edges are complete; neighboring notation is retained below.

Opening low figures and ties, crescendo wedge, full poco cresc. text and continuation dashes, high final run with accidentals and long slur, complete f and long diminuendo hairpin are intact. Some previous/adjacent system ink is retained.

Opening pp, accidentals and upper slurs, both paired hairpin figures, low notes/rests into D, complete D frame and p, and high right-hand sharp/ledger notes/slur are preserved. Neighbor fragments below do not replace target markings.

All seven measures preserve every rapid note group, high ledger peaks, small upper slurs and naturals, clef/key and final barline. Previous-system and neighboring fragments are retained above/below; the target five-line staff remains clear.

All descending groups, upper/lower slurs, ledger notes, naturals/flats, full p cresc. descenders, and final low groups/dots through the last barline are complete. Neighboring material above/below is retained.

review.notes: Independently inspected all three original score pages and 14 enlarged source contexts chosen before consulting crop bounds, then all 14 output strips at source-matched resolution and all three output pages. Every target note group and edge-sensitive marking listed in Tests/extraction/brahms-independent-review.md is present. No whiteout exclusions are applied. Final PDF renders are byte-identical at 216 dpi to the fully inspected preview, and source/destination geometry and band order match. Neighboring notation is intentionally retained under preserve-target and does not make the target staff unreadable. Scope is Violin I, PDF pages 1–3, bars 1–98 only; this is not the complete work or a pitch-by-pitch edition proof. Output retains original source-page boundaries at bars 29 and 58; comfortable performance turns have not been certified. Source scan print size is retained at approximately 96.8% scale.
